title: Built-in subclaim registry
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1 Subclaims; HCert logical model.

statements.label: Built-in subclaim registry
statements.requirement: The library SHALL ship a subclaim registry containing 1 (HCertDCC), 3 (DDCCCoreDataSetVS), 4 (DDCCCoreDataSetTR), 5 (VHL URI), -6 (DVCMin) and -7 (MedicationTreatmentLineMin), each with its status (Assigned, Proposed, Development range) and logical-model canonical URL.

sources.quote: These are the subclaims enumerated by the HCert logical model.
While the logical model enlists assigned sub claims, the ones listed in this specification are considered authoritative
